name: Unified Recruitment Platform
notes: One Docker container: apps/ai serves /api and the built apps/web (STATIC_DIR). Deploys on every push to master via the Launchpad Gitea pipeline, built by the repo-root Dockerfile; GET /api/projects/{id}/pipeline is authoritative for what is live (this file records only the deploy that set it up). The ZIP route (apps/ai/Dockerfile, bundle of server/ + public/) is a manual fallback. GEMINI_API_KEY is in the project env and the Gitea token on the server, neither here. Updates use the key in ~/.config/ued-launchpad/keys/<id>.
